perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.desc: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Indomitability
perks.desc: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 103 from 7 May 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4QnASNlI9E2wArvSynJjVp?si=eb7298468d714686) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content, particularly with a solar subclass. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. Luna's Howl was changed from a Precision to an Adaptive back in the day, so the stats do look weird in comparison to its peers - it's stable and easy to use, but might feel strange if you're used to traditional 140 HCs. Take a barrel perk that gives you a little bit of everything to round things out - Corkscrew, Smallbore or Fluted. For the mag perk, you want the reload as snappy as possible - Flared Magwell has the biggest boost, with Light Mag a close second. There's really only one trait perk combination to search for - Heal Clip (hence the need for reload speed) and Incandescent. Great anyway, but even better when synergising with solar fragments. The Indomitability origin trait seems built for the Prismatic subclass, generating grenade or melee energy according to your subclass type. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Luna's Howl is back and retains its precision frame, while firing at 140 RPM. If you don't have a good Zaouli’s Bane or Igneous Hammer with Heal Clip this can substitute. There's no shortage of Incandescent hand cannons. Magnificent Howl changed from needing precision hits to precision kills, this paired with Lucky Pants can dish out incredible damage, and fan refund itself. It could be very good and fun for lower end PvE content." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I am most excited to use Luna's Howl in the crucible. Precision Instrument doesn't allow you to 2c1b 10 resilience but will allow you to get some lower resilience players. You will want to invest some points into range to really help out the low base range. Magnificent Howl does allow for some fun two taps and blinting moments to keep the chaining going." Recommended MW: Range.
